description: This file defines the InMemoryMembershipTable class used for in-memory management of silo membership data, including reading, updating, inserting, and cleaning up membership entries.

classes.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
classes.description: Manages in-memory storage and operations for silo membership data, including thread-safe insertions, updates, reads, and cleanup procedures.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves membership data associated with a specific silo address.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Returns the complete set of membership data for all silos.

methods.name: ReadTableVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version of the membership table.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry if the silo does not already exist and version matches.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry if it matches the provided ETag and version.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the last alive time of a membership entry.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the table's current state.

methods.name: NewETag
methods.description: Generates a new ETag based on the last counter value.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries of silos that are dead and surpass a specified age.
